Class ControlPanelRenderingSection

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.control.ControlPanelRenderingSection
public class ControlPanelRenderingSection extends Object
3D/2D rendering and projection parameter card for ControlPanel.

Extracted from ControlPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Manages 3D spherical globe transformations, topographic vertical exaggeration $\sigma_{\text{relief}}$, Lambertian hillshading, solar day/night terminator overlays, perceptually uniform palettes, and fullscreen mode.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
